title: beads: remote containers cannot dolt-push through the git proxy (403 on refs/dolt/data) -- BEADS_GITHUB_TOKEN direct-github bypass
description: The web-container git proxy forwards fetches and refs/heads/* pushes but 403s pushes of refs/dolt/data (addTableFiles/updateManifestAddFiles), so remote sessions could read the live bead store but never push writes -- defeating the cross-session tracker (2026-06-11 session had to hand-export deltas via a JSONL handoff branch). FIX: beads_remote_bootstrap.py now honors BEADS_GITHUB_TOKEN: when set, the dolt origin is pointed at git+https://token:<TOKEN>@github.com/<owner>/<repo> (github.com is directly reachable from the container), bypassing the proxy; token masked in all output; falls back to the proxy loudly when unset/unparseable. Maintainer setup: fine-grained PAT (this repo, Contents RW) as BEADS_GITHUB_TOKEN in the Claude Code environment config; upgrade local bd to @latest before/after the first remote push (schema bump caveat, see docs/components/beads-remote-bootstrap.md).
